model.name: Pinch release commits SVG zoom without additional gesture
model.description: Releasing the pinch (lifting both fingers) MUST leave the SVG displayed at the zoom level reached during the pinch — no additional gesture is required to commit the scale.
model.tronQuote:
> TRON (R18.34 refinement source): "its really pinch-pan-release THEN it works, but why the additional pan. total counter intuitive. just pinch-release should simply work. why complex?"
> ARCHITECT (R18.34.B atomic, verbatim 2026-06-09): "Releasing the pinch (lifting both fingers) MUST leave the SVG displayed at the zoom level reached during the pinch — no additional gesture is required to commit the scale."
